Dear Miss Yonge	
I suppose you [illegible] the translation of Alexandre Dumas & after some difficulty we have a shabby copy which I am sending by post.

We will be glad to have the whole [M.S.](../books.html#72) when it is ready.

You can either send it to [Miss Martin](../persons.html#971) or to us
Yours very [illegible]
[Geo Lillie Craik](../persons.html#379)
